title: Script allocator and accounting
summary: Recover 0x4f7d10 custom ECX/EDX allocator wrapper as a state member with explicit VM-error and CRT-jump dependencies. Preserve allocator forwarding, captured accounting owner, modulo byte deltas and allocation-failure status handling.
test_description: 392 direct original/source comparisons cover zero, small, large and wrapping size deltas; null/non-null input and allocator result; allocator mutation of state.global. Assert callback arguments/count, returned pointer, status byte, captured-global accounting, all other state/global bytes and untouched buffers.
known_limits: Protected allocation failure requires CRT longjmp at import 0x92d360; nonlocal transfer is not exercised.
Panic path requires VM prepare-error at 0x4f4d00 and its transitive VM helpers, which have no accepted reference here. The dependency is exposed, not invented, and this path is not behavior-tested.
Original custom register ABI is represented by a GCC test-only regparm adapter; portable implementation uses a member method with explicit error services.
32-bit VM layouts; no matching-byte claim, allocator internals are controlled callbacks.
